title: Ortiz2023: Motor imagery during walking with a lower-limb exoskeleton
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from 10 healthy participants performing kinesthetic motor imagery of gait, relaxation, and a regressive-counting distractor task while walking with a fully assisted lower-limb exoskeleton on flat ground. Data were acquired with a 31-channel setup (27 EEG and 4 EOG) at 200 Hz. It is a BIDS re-release, produced via MOABB, of the DECODED/EUROBENCH database, intended for cognitive assessment of motor imagery and brain-computer interface research.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Brain Products actiCHamp amplifier using Ag/AgCl wet electrodes at 200 Hz, referenced to the left earlobe and grounded at the right earlobe. Online filters were a 0.1 Hz high-pass and a 50 Hz notch. Each trial lasted 9 s and was cued by audio. Participants alternated relaxation, kinesthetic motor imagery of gait, and a regressive-count task across 16 runs.
